create_guidraver_instance: create a GuiDrawer instance with a DebugLineRender and ClientMessageManager for UI rendering
set_line_width: set the global line width for all lines rendered by the GuiDrawer
push_transform: push a Matrix4 transform onto the stack to affect subsequent line drawing operations
draw_box: draw a colored box in world or local space using min and max extent vectors
draw_circle: draw an approximated circle with a specified radius, color, and normal vector
